basis.roster: ScenarioProfile.load_profile filters scn.squadrons by control and retains iteration order; ally flagship is player_flag only. Organization.default_org enables all, auto_all edits personnel/composition, apply preserves list order. BattleSim.initialize spawns ally first; BattleState.next_id=1. FleetBattle3D sets Liu Bei side 0 direct, default FleetState control is delegate.
basis.deadline: BattleState initial tick/clock 0. BattleSim._tick increments tick, then 2×50ms _substep. The first substep increments clock before Victory.check, which runs at tick % 10 = 0. Eligible ms=(tick-1)*100+50. At tick 12000 the clock is 1199950ms. Next eligible is tick 12010 at 1200950ms. Victory priority simultaneous, allied defeat, enemy defeat, limited outcome, timeout.
